name: SonicPad

inputs.description: Your own Sonic Adventure PAL v1.003 disc (MK-5100050) as a GDI: choose the .gdi file, with track01.bin, track02.raw and track03.bin in the same folder. Other releases, CDI and CHD images are not supported.

tools.name: cmake
tools.note: Install CMake 3.24 or newer: brew install cmake

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install full Xcode, open it once, and install the iOS platform.

notes: Sonic Adventure's SH-4 code is translated ahead of time to ARM64 C++ from the player's disc; Flycast (pinned, unmodified) supplies the Dreamcast hardware layer and renders through MoltenVK. No JIT.

publication.reason: Recipe only: the app contains code translated from the player's own disc, so each player builds their own.
